empty.props_model.title: Nothing selected
empty.props_model.hint: Click an element in the view to see its properties. Or export all parameters to a workbook, edit them there and apply back.
tut.spreadsheet.title: XLSX spreadsheet round trip
tut.spreadsheet.1: Press Export to XLSX spreadsheet below: choose what to include and save the workbook.
tut.spreadsheet.2: Open the workbook in a spreadsheet app, change a cell and save it. The preview here shows the change.
tut.spreadsheet.3: Check the preview and press Apply to model. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
